description.narrative: The Fund is expected to increase access to private equity capital and value creation for small cap companies in Morocco. Beyond the Project, its success is expected to validate the business model of a first-time local fund manager, increase interest from international investors, and catalyze larger follow-on funds with broader LP (Limited Partners) participation, thereby deepening Moroccos domestic private equity market. This builds on ongoing World Bank Group efforts, to strengthen the domestic private equity ecosystem.

The proposed project is for IFC to commit up to US$15 million into IMG Fund I (IMG I or the Fund), a growth equity fund targeting MAD1.5 billion (~US$162 million) in commitments to invest primarily in Morocco. The Fund aims to build a portfolio of 7-10 fast-growing lower mid-cap companies, with ticket sizes ranging MAD 60-200 million (US$6-20 million), primarily targeting minority stakes and selectively majority. IMG I will be a generalist fund with a core focus on healthcare, FMCG, digital infrastructure, financial services and education. The Fund will mainly target family-owned businesses looking to institutionalize before or after a succession and opportunistically buy & build. The Fund reached a first close of MAD1.1 billion (~US$120 million) in January 2026, with the participation of Moroccan institutional investors including Fonds Mohammed VI pour lInvestissement (FM6I).
